title: Relations between categorifications of higher-dimensional type $A$ cluster combinatorics
summary: We consider three categories arising from the higher Auslander algebras of type $A$ in relation to $d$-dimensional cluster combinatorics: $d$-exact subcategory of the module category of $A^d_{n+1}$ generated by the $d$-cluster-tilting object, the $(d+2)$-angulated cluster category, and the $d$-almost positive subcategory of the derived category (the higher analogue of the category of two-term complexes of projectives). We show that the third one, introduced by the second-named author, is the $d$-exangulated quotient of the other two, introduced by Oppermann and Thomas, by the ideals…
